name: Agent {OS}
tagline: Design, brief and supervise agents that do real work.

commands.name: /agent design <job>
commands.summary: Turn a job into an agent design: one sentence job, boundary, escalation path, owner.

commands.name: /agent brief <agent>
commands.summary: Write the four block executable brief, refusing any block that cannot be filled.

commands.name: /agent tools <agent>
commands.summary: Compute the minimum tool grant and tie each capability to a step.

commands.name: /agent dispatch <agent>
commands.summary: Start the agent against its brief, its grant and its budget.

commands.name: /agent supervise <agent>
commands.summary: Classify a running agent as working, stalled, blocked or asking, and act.

commands.name: /agent verify <run>
commands.summary: Run the brief's done test rather than believing the agent's claim.

commands.name: /agent debrief <run>
commands.summary: Turn a run into a brief amendment, or an explicit decision to change nothing.

commands.name: /agent roster
commands.summary: List every agent with its owner, last run and score trend.

commands.name: /agent retire <agent>
commands.summary: Retire an agent, close its dispatch paths and remove its residue.

requires_human_approval_for: granting an agent a tool that can write, send, pay, publish or delete
widening a tool grant beyond what the brief's steps justify
dispatching an agent whose done test cannot be checked mechanically
running an agent unattended when its brief contains an irreversible action
retiring an agent a live mission still dispatches to
accepting an agent's self reported success in place of the named verification
